title: Initiative Health Minimap and Decision Brief for Monthly Roadmap Sync
creator: Maya Chen
description: Produce a compact, decision-focused one-pager (minimap) that surfaces initiative health, leading indicators, and 2-3 recommended exec decisions for the monthly roadmap sync. The artifact must fit a single slide and an accompanying 3-bullet email summary for exec consumption.
background: Leadership feedback from prior readouts was that long decks obscure the signal: requests were to standardize a compact view showing initiative health, risk vectors, dependencies, and clear asks. This ticket synthesizes OKR progress, cross-functional blockers, and financial signal to create a repeatable deliverable for monthly ops and quarterly readouts.
decision_summary: Recommend green/amber/red health flags per initiative with a 1-line rationale
Propose two runway-conservative asks: a) commit +10% Dedicated budget for inferencing experiments; b) delay non-critical infra refactor into next quarter if unsafe for SLA
Request approval to retire one low-impact initiative and reallocate points to Optimize batching pilots
metrics_snapshot: OKR pass rate (top-level): 68% vs target 75% (trailing 4 weeks)
Median p95 latency for hosted API: 120ms (SLO 100ms) — regressions in 3 regions
Unit cost per 1k tokens: $0.72, trending +7% QoQ driven by model upgrades
Customer escalations: 4 active (2 enterprise SLA, 2 integration bugs)
risks: Dedicated capacity forecast underestimates peak elastic demand — could cause throttling for 2 high-value customers
Ongoing kernel scheduling experiments may temporarily increase p99 latency for long-seq workloads
Insufficient observability on KV cache hit regressions across model variants
actions: Collect final engineering validation of batch/latency tradeoffs by 2026-03-05 (ENG-47299 dependency)
Lock recommended exec asks and draft 3-bullet email for CEO by 2026-03-08
Schedule a 30-minute dry run with Eng lead + Sales AE to rehearse Q&A on cost impact (owner: Evan Patel)
Add one targeted eval to detect quality regressions for quantized models (owner: ML Research)
